description: Use when you need the official weather forecast for a point in South Korea for the next ~3-5 days. Data: KMA (Korea Meteorological Administration) village forecast on a 5 km grid, issued 8 times a day. Input: lat, lon (WGS84 decimal; Korea only). Output: JSON hourly then 3-hourly temperature C, sky, precipitation type and probability %, rain and snow amounts, humidity %, wind; plus daily min/max. Example: ?lat=37.5665&lon=126.978 Price: $0.0045 USDC via x402.

lat.description: Latitude, WGS84 decimal degrees (KMA domain ≈ 32–44; outside → 400, not charged)

name: kr_weather_forecast
title: Korea short-term weather forecast (KMA) by latitude/longitude
